The operation preserves the product of (1 + x) over all numbers on the board, because (1 + a)(1 + b) = 1 + a + b + ab.

Initially the product is (1 + 1)(1 + 1/2)(1 + 1/3)...(1 + 1/100) = 2 · 3/2 · 4/3 · ... · 101/100 = 101.

If the final number is x, then 1 + x = 101, so x = 100.

ANSWER: 100
